lscpu.data: fpu vme de pse tsc msr pae mce cx8 apic sep mtrr pge mca cmov pat pse36 clflush mmx fxsr sse sse2 ss ht syscall nx pdpe1gb rdtscp lm constant_tsc rep_good nopl xtopology tsc_reliable nonstop_tsc cpuid tsc_known_freq pni pclmulqdq vmx ssse3 fma cx16 pcid sse4_1 sse4_2 x2apic movbe popcnt tsc_deadline_timer aes xsave avx f16c rdrand hypervisor lahf_lm abm 3dnowprefetch ssbd ibrs ibpb stibp ibrs_enhanced tpr_shadow ept vpid ept_ad fsgsbase tsc_adjust bmi1 avx2 smep bmi2 erms invpcid rdseed adx smap clflushopt clwb sha_ni xsaveopt xsavec xgetbv1 xsaves avx_vnni vnmi umip waitpkg gfni vaes vpclmulqdq rdpid movdiri movdir64b fsrm md_clear serialize ibt flush_l1d arch_capabilities
Mitigation; Speculative Store Bypass disabled via prctl
Mitigation; usercopy/swapgs barriers and __user pointer sanitization
Mitigation; Enhanced / Automatic IBRS; IBPB conditional; PBRSB-eIBRS SW sequence; BHI BHI_DIS_S

environment.control_notes: CPU affinity was recorded, but no affinity pinning, background-load isolation, frequency-governor, or power-state control was applied; system load and power state were uncontrolled.

workload.request_order: repeat the first B reference rows; B=256 repeats 64 rows four times
workload.ordering: for each batch/repeat: isolated Runtime process, then fresh server/client processes

measurement.tcp_latency: client steady_clock before send_frame through complete response validation/decode; successful formal requests only
measurement.tcp_wall: formal loop including per-request accounting and last-result ownership, excluding connect/warmup/output
measurement.runtime_latency: benchmark_cli call through future result acquisition, includes owned input copy; window=1
measurement.comparison_limits: TCP input encoded before formal loop; Runtime copies input per request. Different process/scheduling/serialization costs; no pure-network subtraction claim.
measurement.percentiles: nearest rank ceil(p*N); per run, not pooled

result.allocation_probe_scope: Separate direct CpuExecutor probe counts replaceable global C++ operator new/new[] and aligned forms using a thread-local counter; excludes malloc/mmap, input copies, timing records, pool setup and worker-thread allocations. Runtime mode has no allocation probe.
result.rss_scope: Resident pages from /proc/self/statm times page size; sampled with Runtime still alive after warmup and after timing. Includes model, workspaces, threads, bounded pending futures, latency vectors and allocator retention; results consumed and destroyed promptly.
result.peak_rss_scope: getrusage(RUSAGE_SELF) ru_maxrss process high-water mark, Linux KiB converted to bytes; includes startup, preparation, warmup, timing and reporting, not executor-only peak.
result.timing_scope: Formal wall time includes input copies, submissions, rejected attempts, ready-future scans, waits, successful result consumption/destruction and metric recording; setup, warmup, allocation probe, final shutdown and reporting excluded.
result.latency_scope: Successful requests only: call-before (before owned input copy) to future.get result acquisition. queue=start-enqueued under queue lock; execution=finish-start (callable); completion=finish-call-before; collection=acquired-finish; submit=submit-return-call-before. Direct execution has zero queue/collection. All stages include instrumentation overhead.
result.latency_percentile_method: nearest-rank: sorted sample at ceil(p*N), one-indexed
